title: Ohm Boy Valencia Orange & Passion Fruit Nic Salt E-Liquid 20mg
description: A combination of Spanish sunshine and tropical tang, Ohm Boy’s Valencia Orange and Passionfruit is a mouth-watering fruit fusion. Bright, juicy oranges play off the exotic sweetness of passion fruit for a decadently fruity vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
